text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:
I found two Marrow Agrisupply sites in #central-team and a possible third. I've sent you the list in our DM.

1. Eastbank, from Hollis on 2026-06-09 at 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached. The file calls the doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs sorting before anyone reimports, or you'll get duplicate doors.
2. Pine Crossing, from you on 2026-06-09 at 10:48 AM. The morning receiver can only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to try it with the store login.
3. Wichita (not confirmed), from you on 2025-07-02 at 9:21 AM. You mentioned an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher, just after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours. The message never actually says Wichita is a Marrow store, so it's worth checking.

I left out the Tulsa hub in that same 2025 thread because it belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow. The 2026-06-09 escalation also mentions three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker that just say "waiting," but nobody names those stores in the channel, so I can't tell you which they are.
